page_notes.329: Button Head Socket Cap Screw table (catalog 4-165): all rows fractional F hardware (8-32, 10-32, 1/4-20, 5/16-18) in black zinc, stainless and bright zinc; 3940-3948 also carry the RT badge. All rows extracted.
page_notes.331: Button Head Socket Cap Screw (Continued) table is metric/RT only (skipped); Flanged Button Head Socket Cap Screw table: 10 F rows (1/4-20, 5/16-18) extracted, metric M6/M8 rows skipped.

remaining_doubts: 3042: catalog prints A as .354 (no inch mark) and weight .040 lb, an order of magnitude above neighboring 10-32 rows; kept verbatim as printed.

65-prefixed rows (65-3059, 65-3061, 65-3063, 65-3065, 65-3104, 65-3111, 65-3114, 65-3118) repeat the dimensions of the unprefixed Black Zinc parts; the page does not explain the prefix (photo captions mention Black-Coated/Blue-Coated but no row names those finishes).
